description: Store multiple memories atomically in one request (consumes max(1, memories.length) Write API calls; non-idempotent) and return { ids, encoded }. Validates every item namespace before writing so any reserved "org:" prefix aborts the entire batch cleanly; items inherit top-level namespace and default to type="episodic" and salience=0.5. Use when checkpointing or importing 2+ memories together; use encode_memory instead for a single memory write.

memories.description: Non-empty array of memory objects ({ content, type?, salience?, namespace?, context? }).

namespace.description: Optional per-item logical namespace override (never prefix with "org:").
Fallback logical workspace namespace applied to batch items that omit namespace.

name: batch_encode

ids.description: Created memory UUIDs in input order.

title: Batch Encode Memories
